# HexPiece 3.2.7

Nika fruit (Gear 5) rework, part 4: Dawn Whip, scrapped and redone as a cartoon spin. Not tested in game yet: the build and all tests
pass, and the animation was rendered and checked tick by tick.

**Dawn Whip (C with Haki on in Gear 5)**
- A cartoon spin now, like Luffy against Kizaru. You coil back, then your whole body spins round twice like a top, fastest right as the
  stretched leg whips through its target. Then you overshoot, wobble back and stop.
- Your feet pedal in a cartoon blur through the whole spin, one leg kicking forward bent while the other swings back, swapping every
  tick, like a cartoon wheel of feet.
- The plain Gum-Gum Whip (without Haki) is unchanged, and so is first person: the arms you see there are exactly the same.
